verses.text: Ix yalanxi Jehová t'ayin icha tik:
Ach anima, al jantak ya'elal ol och t'a yib'anh jun chonhab' smilancham anima. Ha yuj jantak tas yajb'entak ix sk'ulej,

al t'ay icha tik: Ha Jehová Yajal tz'alan icha tik: Ex aj Jerusalén, ex tze milcham heb' kajan t'a he kal, tze b'oank'e juntzanh yechel sjuanb'at he pensar, yuj chi' a ex tzeyik'kot ya'elal t'a eyib'anh.

Yuj jantak anima ix he milchamok, ol jawok t'a eyib'anh tiknaik. Yuj juntzanh yechel ix he b'ok'ei ix ixtaxel he pensar, yuj chi' toxo ix jawi slajwub' k'ual t'a eyib'anh. Yuj chi' a in swak' sk'ulej masanil nación tzex b'ajani, tzex sb'uchanpaxi.
Tz'el wal eyaw eyak'an chukal t'a heb' eyetanimail, yuj chi' masanil nación ol b'uchwaj t'ayex, heb' ay t'a he lak'anil yet' heb' ay t'a najat.
Ha jantak heb' yajal kajan t'a he kal chi', smilcham anima heb', yujto ay yopisio heb'.
Manhxa yelk'och he mam he nun t'a he sat. Tzeyixtej heb' ch'ok chonhab'il. Tze tok'anek' tastak ay t'a heb' manhxa smam yet' pax t'a heb' ix ix chamnakxo winh yetb'eyum.
Manhxa yelk'och in kajnub' t'a he sat yet' sk'ual ik'oj ip wik yaji.
Ha t'a he kal ay mach sna'ank'e lolonel t'a spatik yetanimail yik smiljichamok. Tzex b'atpax t'a k'inh tz'och t'a jolomtak witz yik tzex och ejmelal t'a komon Dios. Te k'ixwelal tas tze k'ulej ta'.
Ayex tzex mulan yet' ix yetb'eyum he mam, ayex tzex mulan yet' heb' ix ix ayik ayoch heb' ix t'a sb'islab' uj.
Ayex tzex mulan yet' ix yetb'eyum heb' eyetanimail, ayex pax tzex mulan yet' heb' ix eyalib', ayex pax tzex mulan yet' heb' ix eyanab' yisil he mam.

Ha in Jehová in swala', ay heb' eyajalil scha'an tumin yik syak'anoch chamel heb' t'a yib'anh heb' malaj smul. Tzeyixtej heb' eyetanimail, yujto a k'e'en he tumin tzeyak' smajnej heb', niwan yune' k'e'en tze k'aneli. Komonnhej tzeyak'och t'a yib'anh heb' eyetanimail yik tzex och b'eyumal, a inxo tik tzin b'atkan satk'olal eyu'uj.
Te aykot wowal yuj b'aj tzeyixtej heb' anima chi', yuj pax b'aj tze milcham heb'.
¿Tzam he nalaj to ol yal he tek'b'an he b'a t'a wichanh ayik ol wak'an eyaelal? Ha tas toxo ix wal a in Jehová in tik, yowalil ol wak'elk'ochi.
Ol ex in saklemejb'at t'a skaltak nación yet' t'a skaltak masanil chonhab', icha wal chi' ol aj wik'anel he chukal chi'.
K'ixwelal ol eyutejkan he b'a t'a yichanh masanil nación. Icha chi' ol aj snachajel eyu'uj to a in Jehová he Diosal in, xchi Jehová, xa chi, xchi t'ayin.
Ix yalanxi Jehová t'ayin icha tik:

Ach anima, a heb' etisraelal manhxalaj tz'och heb' wu'uj. Lajan wal heb' icha smikal k'e'en plata tz'eli ayik snhusji k'e'en t'a horno, syalelk'ochi haton k'e'en cobre, k'e'en estaño, k'e'en hierro yet' k'e'en plomo.
Yuj chi' a in Jehová Yajal in swal icha tik: Ha ex tik, lajan ex icha smikal k'e'en plata chi', malaj yopisio, yuj chi' ol ex in molb'ej t'a yol chonhab' Jerusalén chi'.

Icha tz'aj k'e'en plata, k'e'en cobre, k'e'en hierro, k'e'en plomo yet' k'e'en estaño, junxonhej tz'aj yak'chajb'at k'e'en t'a yol junok horno, tz'ulaxb'at k'e'en t'a skal k'ak' chi', icha wal chi' ol ex wutej yet' yowal in k'o'ol. Ol ex in molb'ej, ol wak'anoch ya'elal t'a eyib'anh t'a yol chonhab' chi'. Icha wal chi' ol aj snachajel eyu'uj to a in ton Jehová in ix wak'kot yowal in k'ol t'a eyib'anh, xchi Jehová.
Ix yalanxi Jehová t'ayin icha tik:
Ach anima, al t'a heb' etisraelal icha tik: Ha he chonhab', manh wach'ok yaj t'a wichanh, yuj wal yowal in k'o'ol malaj jab'ok nhab' syak'a'.

Ha heb' syaloch sb'a in chekab'ok ayek' t'a he kal, junlajan tz'aj smilwicham anima heb'. Lajan wal heb' icha nok' choj tz'el yaw, skotak tzilchitanb'at schib'ej. Syelk'anb'at sb'eyumal yet' tastak wach' ay t'a heb' anima chi' heb'. Tzijtum heb' ix ix scham yetb'eyum t'a he kal yuj heb'.

Ha heb' sacerdote, a in k'ayb'ub'al yet' juntzanh tas wik yaji ix yixtejb'at heb'. Ha tas wach' yet' tas manh wach'ok t'a yichanh ley, malaj sk'exanhil t'a sat heb'. Max k'ayb'aj heb' anima yuj heb' yik syojtakejel heb' tas wach' yet' tas manh wach'ok. Hanhejtona' max sk'anab'ajej in k'ual ik'oj ip heb'. Yuj chi' chekel to malaj welk'och t'a sat heb'.
Ha heb' yajal yaj t'a he chonhab' chi', smilcham anima heb', yujto snib'ej wal heb' tz'och b'eyumal, lajan wal heb' icha nok' okes skotak tzilchitejb'at schib'ej.

Ha heb' syaloch sb'a in chekab'ok, a tas manh wach'ok sk'ub'ejel heb', icha tz'aj yoch k'e'en ta'anh t'a junok k'a pat. Syalan heb' to ay tas swak' yil heb', syalanel esal lolonel heb'. Syal heb' to a in swak' juntzanh lolonel chi' yal heb', palta wal yel malaj tas tzin chek yalel heb'.

Ha heb' anima sk'e wal cha'anh heb' yixtan yetanimail yet' elk'al. Ha wal heb' meb'a' malaj tas ay t'ay, a heb' syixtej heb'. Yelxo wal manh tojolok tas sk'ulej heb' t'a heb' ch'ok chonhab'il kajan t'a skal heb'.
Ha in tik, ix in sayek' t'a skal he chonhab' chi', talaj ay junok mach wach'takto wal spensar, stewi t'ayin yuj schonhab' yik wach' max in sateli, palta malaj junok mach ix ilchaj wu'uj.

Yuj chi' a in Jehová in swak'b'at ya'elal t'a yib'anh heb', ol in satel heb' yet' in k'ak'alk'olal. Icha chi' ol aj sjawi t'a yib'anh heb' yuj chukal sk'ulej, xchi Jehová, xa chi t'a heb', xchi t'ayin.
